script.caption: Keys in the same pocket. Bag off the lane. Then push.
script.hook: Before I push the sled, I empty my pockets.
script.spoken:
Before I push the sled, I empty my pockets.
Keys go in the zipped pocket of my bag. Same spot every time, so I know where to look later.
Then I leave the bag off the lane and get on with the push.

shots.action: Pull your keys out and hold them up for a beat.
shots.location: Gym bench beside the sled lane
shots.placement: Brace the phone against your bag on the bench, clear of the lane.
shots.simplerAlternative: Skip the hold and cut as the keys come out.
shots.words: Before I push the sled, I empty my pockets.

shots.action: Drop the keys into the pocket and zip it shut.
shots.framing: Fill the frame with your hands and the pocket.
shots.placement: Brace the phone against one end of the bag and aim it along the bench at the zip.
shots.simplerAlternative: Keep the first camera angle and zip the pocket in view.
shots.words: Keys go in the zipped pocket of my bag. Same spot every time, so I know where to look later.

shots.action: Walk to the sled, grip the handles and push through the frame.
shots.framing: Show yourself and the sled from the side.
shots.placement: Brace the phone against the bag on the bench outside the lane and aim it across the start.
shots.simplerAlternative: Keep the phone still and show just the start of the push.
shots.words: Then I leave the bag off the lane and get on with the push.
